title: Dallas Summer Musicals Program - Sweet Charity, June-July 1971
descriptionText: The "Dallas Summers Musicals Program" for the dates June 19 - July 11, 1971 features the musical "Sweet Charity." This souvenir program provides a glimpse into the theater industry during that time period, showcasing the performers, productions, and events held at the Dallas Theater Center. With a focus on musicals, this program serves as a collectible piece of entertainment memorabilia, offering a unique look into the world of theater in the 1970s.
